text: === FILE src/venue/export.ts === ⏎ import { parseTranscriptExport } from "@flop-labs/tclk"; ⏎ import type { Transport } from "./types.js"; ⏎ export class BadResponseError extends Error { ⏎ constructor( ⏎ public status: number, ⏎ message: string, ⏎ ) { ⏎ super(message); ⏎ this.name = "BadResponseError"; ⏎ } ⏎ } ⏎ export async function exportRoom( ⏎ transport: Transport, ⏎ base: string, ⏎ room: string, ⏎ ): Promise<{ ⏎ text: string; ⏎ generation: string | null; ⏎ records: Array<{ seq: number; line: string }>; ⏎ }> { ⏎ const url = `${base}/r/${room}/export`; ⏎ const response = await transport({ url }); ⏎ if (response.status < 200 || response.status >= 300) { ⏎ const message = response.body.trim(); ⏎ throw new BadResponseError(response.status, `${response.status} ${message}`); ⏎ } ⏎ const text = response.body; ⏎ const generation = response.headers["x-room-generation"] ?? null; ⏎ const records = parseTranscriptExport(text); ⏎ return { text, generation, records }; ⏎ }
